detailed_descriptions.en: Wizards are waging war among the skies to conquer a shattered world. Lay claim to your skyshard and build a city full of magical buildings and enchanted weapons! Building and Battling SkyShard is a fantasy city-building auto-battler where you’ll need to outsmart your opponents by assembling the most powerful city you can. It will take a combination of careful resource management and planning to acquire the right buildings for your town, along with clever positioning of your buildings to unlock surprising and potent effects. As your town grows, other players will attack with their own skyshards, and you’ll need to survive 16 rounds to win. Sometimes they’ll surprise you with a humbling defeat, but that’s the best way to learn! With asynchronous PVP , there’s absolutely no time pressure. You can take as long as you like to arrange your city perfectly. Only the wisest wizards can achieve a perfect victory or climb the leaderboard and achieve the rank of Archmage! Endless Buildings and Synergies In the world of SkyShard, you’ll encounter buildings from a variety of factions , each with their own special abilities, and embracing them all can give you a big advantage. The Tinker faction uses gnomish technology to make buildings operate at peak efficiency , but it can definitely backfire. Magic harnesses explosive powers that can deal lots of damage to entire neighborhoods. Nature is all about gaining health and staying alive, even against the most aggressive enemies. You’ll encounter even more factions with 170+ unique buildings that have diverse and formidable effects to discover. Truly Independent We made SkyShard to be a game that puts players first. We’re two meager strategy-gaming YouTubers, ItsBen321 and RegisKillbin, who got tired of games always making decisions that were focused on monetization and forced engagement So we decided to put our money and time where our mouths are, and make our own game! We might make some mistakes along the way, this is our first game after all, but we’ll always be around on YouTube and Twitch, listening to players, and working to make the game better and keeping players updated on our thoughts, plans, challenges, and triumphs. Now you get out there and build an amazing city, while we go and build an awesome game!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Wizards are waging war among the skies to conquer a shattered world. Lay claim to your skyshard and build a city full of magical buildings and enchanted weapons!

Building and Battling

SkyShard is a fantasy city-building auto-battler where you’ll need to outsmart your opponents by assembling the most powerful city you can. It will take a combination of careful resource management and planning to acquire the right buildings for your town, along with clever positioning of your buildings to unlock surprising and potent effects.

As your town grows, other players will attack with their own skyshards, and you’ll need to survive 16 rounds to win. Sometimes they’ll surprise you with a humbling defeat, but that’s the best way to learn! With asynchronous PVP, there’s absolutely no time pressure. You can take as long as you like to arrange your city perfectly. 

Only the wisest wizards can achieve a perfect victory or climb the leaderboard and achieve the rank of Archmage!

Endless Buildings and Synergies

In the world of SkyShard, you’ll encounter buildings from a variety of factions, each with their own special abilities, and embracing them all can give you a big advantage.

  • The Tinker faction uses gnomish technology to make buildings operate at peak efficiency, but it can definitely backfire.

  • Magic harnesses explosive powers that can deal lots of damage to entire neighborhoods. 

  • Nature is all about gaining health and staying alive, even against the most aggressive enemies. 

You’ll encounter even more factions with 170+ unique buildings that have diverse and formidable effects to discover. 

Truly Independent

We made SkyShard to be a game that puts players first. We’re two meager strategy-gaming YouTubers, ItsBen321 and RegisKillbin, who got tired of games always making decisions that were focused on monetization and forced engagement

So we decided to put our money and time where our mouths are, and make our own game!

We might make some mistakes along the way, this is our first game after all, but we’ll always be around on YouTube and Twitch, listening to players, and working to make the game better and keeping players updated on our thoughts, plans, challenges, and triumphs.

Now you get out there and build an amazing city, while we go and build an awesome game!
